text.zh: 非对称模型结构，小成本大智能。
text.en: Asymmetric architecture: more intelligence, less cost.

text.zh: 性能比肩顶级闭源模型。
text.en: Performance rivaling the world's top closed-source models.

text.zh: 更强、更快、更普惠。
text.en: Smarter, faster, more affordable.

text.zh: 新一代智能，专为解决最艰深的知识工作和编程难题。
text.en: Next generation of intelligence for the hardest knowledge work and coding problems.

text.zh: 面向网络安全与生物学研究，仅向经过审核的机构开放。
text.en: Built for cybersecurity and biology research, with access limited to vetted organizations.

text.zh: 面向复杂编程与 AI 智能体的混合推理模型。
text.en: A hybrid reasoning model built for complex coding and AI agents.

text.zh: 面向实时智能体与高吞吐场景的混合推理模型。
text.en: A hybrid reasoning model for real-time agents and high-volume work.

text.zh: 面向速度敏感的高吞吐场景，响应快、成本低。
text.en: For speed-sensitive, high-volume workloads at low cost.

text.zh: 擅长编程、写作与复杂分析。
text.en: Strong at coding, writing and complex analysis.

text.zh: 为 Codex 智能体编程优化，可并行处理多项软件工程任务。
text.en: Optimized for agentic coding in Codex, handling several software tasks in parallel.

text.zh: 面向计算机操作、编程、网络安全与科学研究中最艰深的问题。
text.en: For the hardest problems in computer use, coding, cybersecurity and science.

text.zh: 面向日常工作，擅长写作、编程与分析。
text.en: For everyday work: writing, coding and analysis.

text.zh: 响应快、成本低，适合高频与可重复的任务。
text.en: Optimized for fast responses and high-volume, repeatable work.

text.zh: 面向编程与专业工作，原生支持计算机操作。
text.en: For coding and professional work, with native computer use.

text.zh: 内置思考、可配置推理强度，面向编程与智能体任务。
text.en: Thinking built in with configurable reasoning effort, for coding and agentic tasks.

text.zh: 作答前先深入思考，擅长多步推理。
text.en: Trained to think before answering, strong at multi-step reasoning.

text.zh: OpenAI 的开放权重推理模型，Apache 2.0 许可，分 120B 与 20B 两种规模，可自托管。
text.en: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning models under Apache 2.0, in 120B and 20B sizes, self-hostable.

text.zh: 支持文本与图像输入，覆盖多种语言。
text.en: Text and image input across many languages.

text.zh: 面向真实软件工程、企业知识工作与网络安全防御的前沿模型，擅长长程复杂任务。
text.en: A frontier model for real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cyber defense, built for long-horizon workflows.

text.zh: 面向复杂任务、深度推理与多模态理解。
text.en: For complex tasks, deep reasoning and multimodal understanding.

text.zh: 速度与成本优先，面向规模化智能体任务与高频低延迟场景。
text.en: Speed and cost first, for high-volume low-latency work and agentic tasks at scale.

text.zh: 原生理解文本、图像、视频与音频。
text.en: Native text, image, video and audio understanding.

text.zh: 源自 Gemini 研究，从云端服务器到手机都能运行。
text.en: Built from the same research as Gemini, running from cloud servers to phones.

text.zh: Gemini 图像生成与编辑模型，支持自然语言对话式创建与修改。
text.en: Gemini's image generation and editing model, with conversational creation and refinement.

text.zh: Flash 档的高吞吐版本，适合高频任务。
text.en: The high-throughput variant of the Flash tier, for high-frequency work.

text.zh: 该系列首个原生多模态模型，320B 总参数，MIT 许可开放权重。
text.en: The series' first natively multimodal model: 320B parameters, open weights under MIT.

text.zh: 最强的开放权重编程模型之一，擅长长时间自主任务。
text.en: One of the most capable open-weight coding models, built for long-horizon autonomy.

text.zh: 更快更省的多模态推理，兼顾日常编程。
text.en: Fast, low-cost multimodal inference that handles everyday coding.

text.zh: 覆盖对话、编程与智能体，支持思考模式与函数调用。
text.en: Covers chat, coding and agents, with thinking mode and function calling.

text.zh: 开放权重模型，以代码、金融研究与长程 Agent 任务见长。
text.en: An open-weight model, strong at coding, financial research and long-horizon agent work.

text.zh: 面向编程与知识工作的 2.8T 开放权重模型。
text.en: An open-weight 2.8T model for coding and knowledge work.

text.zh: 长程编程智能体模型的高速版本，开放权重。
text.en: The high-speed tier of the open-weight agentic coding model, for long-horizon work.

text.zh: 面向长程编程的开放权重智能体模型，1T 总参数。
text.en: An open-weight agentic coding model for long-horizon work, with 1T parameters.

text.zh: 原生支持文本、图像与视频输入，含思考模式与工具调用。
text.en: Native text, image and video input, with thinking mode and tool calling.

text.zh: 面向编程与办公的 2.4 万亿参数 MoE，支持思考模式与内置工具。
text.en: A 2.4T-parameter MoE for coding and office work, with thinking mode and built-in tools.

text.zh: 开放权重 MoE，面向补全、生成与仓库级修改。
text.en: Open-weight MoE for completion, generation and repo-level edits.

text.zh: 响应快、成本低，工具调用支持完整。
text.en: Fast and cheap, with full tool calling.

text.zh: 能力与成本均衡，完整工具调用支持。
text.en: Balanced cost and capability with full tool calling.

text.zh: MoE 架构，单位成本低于同规模稠密模型。
text.en: A mixture-of-experts model that costs less to serve than a dense model of its size.

text.zh: 可本地或低成本部署。
text.en: Cheap to serve, or run locally.

text.zh: 开放权重与云端 API 并行，覆盖文本、图像、音频与视频。
text.en: Open weights and cloud APIs across text, image, audio and video.

text.zh: 面向编程与专业知识工作，原生支持文本、图像与视频输入。
text.en: For coding and professional knowledge work, with native text, image and video input.

text.zh: 面向智能体与代码任务的 198B 稀疏 MoE，支持图像与视频理解。
text.en: A 198B sparse MoE for agentic and coding tasks, with image and video understanding.

text.zh: 覆盖文本推理、多模态与语音，经官方开放平台提供。
text.en: Reasoning, multimodal understanding and voice, served through the official open platform.

text.zh: 兼具前沿编程能力与原生多模态的开放权重模型。
text.en: An open-weight model combining frontier coding with native multimodality.

text.zh: 主打智能体推理、工具调用、编程与多模态输入。
text.en: Agentic reasoning, tool use, coding and multimodal input.

text.zh: 小而快、原生多模态推理，驱动 Meta AI。
text.en: Small and fast by design, natively multimodal, powering Meta AI.

text.zh: 扩散架构大语言模型，主打超低延迟生成。
text.en: Diffusion-architecture LLMs built for ultra-low-latency generation.

text.zh: 扩散架构，面向代码生成，以极快的生成速度见长。
text.en: Diffusion-based and built for code, with very fast generation.

text.zh: 面向复杂专业工作、金融与科研。
text.en: For complex professional work, finance and science.

text.zh: MIT 许可的开放权重 MoE 模型。
text.en: An MIT-licensed open-weight MoE model.

text.zh: 全球最智能的模型之一，原生支持工具调用与实时搜索。
text.en: One of the most intelligent models in the world, with native tool use and real-time search.

text.zh: 覆盖编程、智能体与知识工作，API 支持多模态输入。
text.en: Coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, with multimodal API input.

text.zh: 分 Pro 与 Turbo 两档的生产力智能体模型，擅长通用任务与代码。
text.en: A productivity agent model in Pro and Turbo tiers, strong at general agentic and coding tasks.

text.zh: 覆盖对话、编程与多模态，经大规模线上业务验证。
text.en: Chat, coding and multimodal work, proven across large-scale production use.

text.zh: 2.4 万亿参数的原生全模态大模型。
text.en: A native omni-modal model with 2.4 trillion parameters.

text.zh: 产业级知识增强，支持中文理解与多模态生成。
text.en: Industry-grade knowledge enhancement, with Chinese understanding and multimodal generation.

text.zh: 中文理解与智能体场景表现均衡。
text.en: Balanced for Chinese language and agentic scenarios.

text.zh: 面向代码补全、FIM 与生成。
text.en: Built for code completion, FIM and generation.

text.zh: Apache 2.0 许可的开放权重多模态 MoE，675B 总参数。
text.en: An Apache 2.0 open-weight multimodal MoE with 675B parameters.

text.zh: 从云端到边缘的前沿模型，开放权重与商用并行，可 API 调用或自托管。
text.en: Frontier models from cloud to edge, open-weight and commercial, via API or self-hosting.

text.zh: 可自由微调、蒸馏并部署到任何环境。
text.en: Fine-tune, distill and deploy it anywhere.

text.zh: 把大模型、搜索与自动化整合进同一个企业级安全工作空间。
text.en: LLMs, search and automation combined into one secure enterprise workspace.

text.zh: 面向工具调用、RAG 与多语言任务。
text.en: For tool use, RAG and multilingual work.

text.zh: 面向边缘与本地部署的小模型，擅长推理、数学与代码。
text.en: Small models for edge and local use, strong at reasoning, math and code.

text.zh: 亚马逊的多模态模型，支持文本、图像与视频输入。
text.en: Amazon's multimodal models, taking text, image and video input.

text.zh: 结合实时网络信息作答并附上引用来源，覆盖轻量问答到多步深度研究。
text.en: Search APIs answering with fresh web data and citations, from quick answers to multi-step deep research.
